```{r setup, include = FALSE}
hmdb_path <- "~/Code_Projs/DietMicrobeNet/Data/hmdb.csv"

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
```

## Packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(scales)
library(ggpubr)
library(gt)

source(here::here("R", "functions.R"))
dir.create("figures/DM", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Data

```{r data}
ko_abundance_shotgun <- read_tsv("data/DM/DM_KOs_shotgun.tsv")
metadata   <- read_excel("data/DM/metadata.xlsx")
hmdb       <- read_hmdb(hmdb_path)
hmdb_u     <- hmdb %>% distinct(kegg_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
kegg_names <- kegg_compound_names("data/cache/kegg_compound_names.rds")
host_kos   <- read_csv("data/host_genome/noquote_ko_host.txt", col_names = "ko")

sampleids <- colnames(ko_abundance_shotgun)[-1]
metadata %>%
  filter(SampleID %in% sampleids) %>%
  count(Diet, name = "n_diet")

all_data <- read_collapsed_results("data/DM/graph_results_DM.csv.gz") %>%
  filter(output == "output_dmh") %>%
  mutate(ID = run_dir) %>%
  select(ID, everything(), -run_dir, -output)

n_distinct(all_data$ID)

all_data$RecordID <- sub("\\.1$", "", all_data$ID)

results <- metadata %>%
  distinct(RecordID, Diet) %>%
  right_join(all_data, by = "RecordID")
```

## Q1: Dietary compounds used by microbes (node 1)

```{r sanity checks}
# participants assigned more than one diet
metadata %>%
  group_by(RecordID) %>%
  summarise(n_diets    = n_distinct(Diet, na.rm = TRUE),
            diets_seen = paste(unique(na.omit(Diet)), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_diets > 1)

# TMA/O pathway
ko_abundance_shotgun[startsWith(ko_abundance_shotgun$`Gene Family`, "K20038"), ]
results %>% filter(compound1_id == "C00114")

# diet -> microbe -> host patterns
results %>%
  filter(compound1_origin == "diet", compound2_origin == "microbe", compound3_origin == "host")
```

```{r node heatmap, fig.width=11, fig.height=10}
res_use <- results %>% filter(RecordID %in% unique(metadata$RecordID))
n_total <- n_distinct(res_use$RecordID)

# one row per individual x node x compound, for paths whose microbial step has reads
long <- res_use %>%
  filter(edge1_m_abundance > 0) %>%
  select(RecordID, matches("^compound[123]_(id|origin)$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-RecordID,
               names_to = c("node", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "compound(\\d)_(id|origin)") %>%
  rename(kegg_id = id) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kegg_id)) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, node, origin, kegg_id)

heat_dat <- long %>%
  left_join(hmdb_u, by = "kegg_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxonomy_class)) %>%
  count(node, origin, taxonomy_super_class, taxonomy_class, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(mean_per_patient = n / n_total)

# classified vs. unclassified compounds
long %>%
  left_join(hmdb_u, by = "kegg_id") %>%
  distinct(kegg_id, taxonomy_class) %>%
  summarise(na_count = sum(is.na(taxonomy_class)),
            not_na   = sum(!is.na(taxonomy_class)))

diet_node1 <- long %>%
  filter(node == 1, origin == "diet") %>%
  left_join(hmdb_u, by = "kegg_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxonomy_class))

diet_tab <- diet_node1 %>%
  left_join(kegg_names, by = "kegg_id") %>%
  group_by(taxonomy_super_class, taxonomy_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_per_patient = n / n_total,
            individuals = n_distinct(RecordID),
            compounds = paste(sort(unique(compound_name)), collapse = "; "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_per_patient))

diet_compounds <- diet_node1 %>%
  group_by(taxonomy_class, kegg_id) %>%
  summarise(individuals = n_distinct(RecordID), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(kegg_names, by = "kegg_id") %>%
  select(taxonomy_class, kegg_id, compound_name, individuals) %>%
  arrange(taxonomy_class, desc(individuals))

diet_gt <- diet_tab %>%
  select(taxonomy_super_class, taxonomy_class, n, mean_per_patient, individuals, compounds) %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(
    taxonomy_super_class = "Super class",
    taxonomy_class       = "Class",
    n                    = "Detections (n)",
    mean_per_patient     = "Mean per individual",
    individuals          = "Individuals",
    compounds            = "Compounds"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(mean_per_patient, decimals = 2) %>%
  cols_align("left", c(taxonomy_super_class, taxonomy_class, compounds)) %>%
  cols_width(compounds ~ px(350)) %>%
  tab_header(title = "Diet-only compounds at node 1") %>%
  tab_source_note(paste0("Mean per individual = detections / ", n_total,
                         " individuals. Individuals = number with at least one compound in the class."))
diet_gt
# gtsave(diet_gt, "figures/DM/table_node1.png")

p_nodes_origin <- heat_dat %>%
  mutate(taxonomy_super_class = str_squish(str_remove(taxonomy_super_class, "compounds")),
         origin = factor(origin, levels = c("diet", "microbe", "host", "microbediet",
                                            "hostdiet", "hostmicrobe", "all"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = node, y = taxonomy_class, fill = mean_per_patient)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#00203FFF", high = "#ADEFD1FF",
                      name = "Mean compounds\nper individual",
                      trans = "log10", labels = label_comma()) +
  facet_grid(taxonomy_super_class ~ origin, scales = "free", space = "free",
             labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barwidth = unit(4, "cm"))) +
  labs(x = "Node", y = "Chemical Taxonomy Class",
       title = "Number of Compounds by Node Position and Origin")
p_nodes_origin

ggsave(filename = "figures/DM/compound_nodes.png", p_nodes_origin, width = 14, height = 15)
```

## Q2: Host capability (edge 2)

```{r host enrichment, fig.height=15, fig.width=10}
# host KOs reachable from the microbiome, restricted to the host reference genome
kos <- results %>%
  filter(edge1_m_abundance > 0) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, edge2_KOs) %>%
  mutate(ko = parse_py_list(edge2_KOs)) %>%
  unnest(ko) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, ko) %>%
  filter(ko %in% host_kos$ko)

# KOs present in at least `min_patients` patients
min_patients <- 1
ko_set <- kos %>% count(ko) %>% filter(n >= min_patients) %>% pull(ko)

# background = all KOs in the host reference genome
enrich_host_df <- run_ko_enrichment(ko_set,
                                    universe     = unique(host_kos$ko),
                                    pvalueCutoff = 1,
                                    qvalueCutoff = 1) %>%
  as.data.frame()

sig <- enrich_host_df %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)

# ko04981 (Folate transport and metabolism) has no KEGG category
sum(is.na(sig$category))
sig[is.na(sig$subcategory) & is.na(sig$category), "subcategory"] <- "Digestive system"
sig[is.na(sig$category), "category"] <- "Organismal Systems"

p_host_enrichment <- sig %>%
  mutate(category = ifelse(category == "Genetic Information Processing", "GIP*", category)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Description, -log10(p.adjust)), y = Count, fill = p.adjust)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(.rows = label_wrap_gen(width = 13))) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "blue") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        strip.clip = "off",
        axis.text.y = element_text(lineheight = 0.8, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Pathway", y = "Gene Count", title = "Host KEGG Enrichment",
       caption = "*Genetic Information Processing")
p_host_enrichment

ggsave(filename = "figures/DM/host_gene_enrichment.png", p_host_enrichment, width = 10, height = 15)
```

```{r host kos vs markers, fig.height=10, fig.width=9}
markers_keep    <- c("LDL", "HDL", "IL6", "CRP", "LBP",
                     "CD4+CD40+", "CD4+ PD1+", "CD8+CD40+", "CD8+PD1+")
drop_overview   <- TRUE   # drop KEGG "Global and overview maps"
min_pairs       <- 8      # min patients for a count correlation
min_pairs_model <- 10     # min patients for the regression models
min_minor       <- 2      # KO present in >= this many patients and absent in >= this many
min_blocks      <- 2      # pathway needs >= this many independent KO blocks

# one row per KO in each significantly enriched pathway
sig_ko <- sig %>%
  select(category, subcategory, Description, geneID) %>%
  filter(!(drop_overview & subcategory %in% "Global and overview maps")) %>%
  separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
  rename(ko = geneID) %>%
  distinct()

# host KOs available to each patient (edges whose microbial step has reads)
host_ko <- results %>%
  filter(edge1_m_abundance > 0) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, edge2_KOs) %>%
  mutate(ko = str_extract_all(edge2_KOs, "K\\d{5}")) %>%
  unnest(ko) %>%
  distinct(RecordID, ko)

sig_ko_host <- inner_join(sig_ko, host_ko, by = "ko", relationship = "many-to-many")

patients <- unique(host_ko$RecordID)
diet_key <- metadata %>% distinct(RecordID, Diet)

# marker change from week 1
host_deltas <- metadata %>%
  select(RecordID, Week, all_of(markers_keep)) %>%
  filter(RecordID %in% patients) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(RecordID, Week), names_to = "marker", values_to = "value",
               values_transform = as.numeric) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Week, values_from = value, names_prefix = "wk") %>%
  mutate(d_wk2 = wk2 - wk1,
         d_wk3 = wk3 - wk1)

deltas_long <- host_deltas %>%
  pivot_longer(c(d_wk2, d_wk3), names_to = "change", values_to = "delta") %>%
  filter(!is.na(delta)) %>%
  left_join(diet_key, by = "RecordID")

description_category <- sig_ko %>%
  distinct(Description, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(Description, category)

# number of KOs vs marker change, at three levels
cors_levels <- map_dfr(c(category = "category", subcategory = "subcategory", pathway = "Description"),
                       cor_by_level,
                       sig_ko_host = sig_ko_host, deltas_long = deltas_long,
                       patients = patients, min_pairs = min_pairs,
                       .id = "level") %>%
  arrange(p)

knitr::kable(cors_levels %>% filter(p < 0.05))

p_cors <- cors_levels %>%
  filter(level == "pathway") %>%
  rename(Description = group) %>%
  left_join(description_category, by = "Description") %>%
  mutate(star   = if_else(p < 0.05, "*", ""),
         change = ifelse(change == "d_wk2", "Week 2 - Week 1", "Week 3 - Week 1")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(marker, reorder(Description, rho), fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star)) +
  facet_grid(category ~ change, scales = "free", space = "free_y",
             labeller = labeller(category = label_wrap_gen(20))) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#00203FFF", mid = "white", high = "#4DB6A0",
                       limits = c(-1, 1), name = "rho") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), strip.clip = "off",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Spearman Correlation\nNumber of host KOs vs marker change")
p_cors

ggsave("figures/DM/marker_cors.png", plot = p_cors, width = 9, height = 10)
```

```{r detailed plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=15}
tied_paths <- c("Thiamine metabolism", "Taurine and hypotaurine metabolism",
                "Phenylalanine, tyrosine and tryptophan biosynthesis",
                "Pantothenate and CoA biosynthesis", "One carbon pool by folate",
                "Folate biosynthesis", "Carbon fixation by Calvin cycle",
                "Arginine biosynthesis", "Phenylalanine metabolism",
                "Isoquinoline alkaloid biosynthesis")

interesting_cors <- cors_levels %>%
  filter(level == "pathway", p < 0.05) %>%
  distinct(group, marker, change)

n_sig_ko_host <- sig_ko_host %>%
  filter(Description %in% interesting_cors$group) %>%
  count(RecordID, group = Description, name = "n_ko")

detail_df <- deltas_long %>%
  select(RecordID, marker, change, delta, Diet) %>%
  left_join(n_sig_ko_host, by = "RecordID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  semi_join(interesting_cors, by = c("change", "marker", "group"))

p_detailcor_1 <- detail_df %>%
  filter(!group %in% tied_paths) %>%
  mutate(change = ifelse(change == "d_wk2", "Week 2 - Week 1", "Week 3 - Week 1")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta, y = n_ko, color = Diet)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x = 0, label.y.npc = "bottom") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(group ~ change + marker, scales = "free", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 17)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        strip.clip = "off",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Delta", y = "Number of KOs",
       title = "Correlations of Markers Stratified by Diet - No Ties",
       subtitle = "Deltas and markers were chosen from correlation heatmap")
p_detailcor_1

ggsave(filename = "figures/DM/p_detailcor.png", p_detailcor_1, width = 15, height = 12)

p_detailcor_2 <- detail_df %>%
  filter(change == "d_wk3", group %in% tied_paths) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = delta, y = n_ko, color = Diet)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(method = "spearman", label.x.npc = "middle") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(group ~ marker, scales = "free", labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 15)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        strip.clip = "off",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Delta (Week3 - Week1)", y = "Number of KOs",
       title = "Correlations of Markers Stratified by Diet - Ties Between Markers",
       subtitle = "Deltas and markers were chosen from correlation heatmap")
p_detailcor_2

ggsave(filename = "figures/DM/p_detailcor_ties.png", p_detailcor_2, width = 10, height = 15)
```

```{r ko variation}
# patient x KO presence matrix
ko_pa <- sig_ko_host %>%
  distinct(RecordID, ko) %>%
  mutate(v = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ko, values_from = v, values_fill = 0)
mat <- as.matrix(select(ko_pa, -RecordID))
rownames(mat) <- ko_pa$RecordID

# informative KOs, collapsed into blocks with identical patient profiles
prev    <- colSums(mat)
var_ko  <- names(prev)[prev >= min_minor & prev <= nrow(mat) - min_minor]
profile <- apply(mat[, var_ko, drop = FALSE], 2, paste, collapse = "")
blocks  <- tibble(ko = var_ko, block = paste0("B", match(profile, unique(profile))))
c(variable_KOs = length(var_ko), independent_blocks = n_distinct(blocks$block))

bmat <- mat[, var_ko[!duplicated(profile)], drop = FALSE]
colnames(bmat) <- paste0("B", seq_len(ncol(bmat)))
bmat_long <- as_tibble(bmat, rownames = "RecordID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-RecordID, names_to = "block", values_to = "has")

# pathway score = share of the pathway's blocks a patient carries
pw_block <- sig_ko_host %>%
  distinct(Description, ko) %>%
  inner_join(blocks, by = "ko") %>%
  distinct(Description, block)

# pathways with identical block sets: keep one, record the rest
pw_alias <- pw_block %>%
  group_by(Description) %>%
  summarise(key = paste(sort(block), collapse = "|"), n_blocks = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_blocks >= min_blocks) %>%
  group_by(key) %>%
  summarise(same_as = paste(Description, collapse = "; "),
            Description = first(Description),
            .groups = "drop")

score <- pw_block %>%
  filter(Description %in% pw_alias$Description) %>%
  inner_join(bmat_long, by = "block", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(RecordID, Description) %>%
  summarise(frac = mean(has), .groups = "drop")

model_res <- score %>%
  inner_join(deltas_long, by = "RecordID", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(Description, marker, change) %>%
  filter(n() >= min_pairs_model, n_distinct(frac) > 2, n_distinct(Diet) == 2) %>%
  nest(data = c(RecordID, frac, delta, wk1, Diet)) %>%
  mutate(res = map(data, fit_marker_models)) %>%
  select(-data) %>%
  unnest(res) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_main)) %>%
  group_by(marker, change) %>%
  mutate(q_main = p.adjust(p_main, "BH"),
         q_int  = p.adjust(p_int, "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(q_main_all = p.adjust(p_main, "BH"),
         q_int_all  = p.adjust(p_int, "BH")) %>%
  left_join(select(pw_alias, Description, same_as), by = "Description") %>%
  arrange(p_int)

model_res %>% filter(p_main < 0.05 | p_int < 0.05)
```

```{r ldl by n reactions}
n_rx <- results %>%
  distinct(RecordID, Diet, edge2_reaction) %>%
  count(Diet, RecordID)

metadata %>%
  select(RecordID, LDL, Week) %>%
  filter(Week %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
  mutate(LDL = as.numeric(as.character(LDL))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Week, values_from = LDL, names_prefix = "Week_") %>%
  mutate(LDL_change = Week_2 - Week_1) %>%
  left_join(n_rx, by = "RecordID") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = LDL_change, color = Diet)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "number of reactions")
```
